title: Standing Charter
description: A human-written standing authorization for a role to initiate a commission on a cadence or event. A charter can start work; it can never widen what any role may execute. It is the calendar half of a standing approval.

owner_role.description: The role that initiates: chief-of-staff (company-wide) or a department index role such as marketing (a 'marketing director' charter).

event.description: Dotted event name, e.g. yalloha.review.created. The private runner maps it to a webhook or poll.

commission.description: The objective handed to the Chief of Staff, verbatim.

max_external_actions.description: Cap on external tool calls in one run. 0 means draft-only runs.

standing_approvals.description: Standing approvals this charter may rely on. Each must exist as a human-written file at run time; the charter cannot create them.

notify.description: Where the run summary goes (ref, not a secret).
